Design backend improvements to handle hierarchical memory layers with efficient synchronization and conflict resolution.

- Extend data schema to tag messages with memory layer (global, room, personal).

- Optimize data storage and retrieval for performance, possibly with caching per layer.
- Add endpoints to update or delete messages with layer awareness.
